title: Trade Desk's market cap fell ~70% from a December 2024 peak as it contends with frustrated agency partners, competition from Google, and a new entrant, Amazon (Patience Haggin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Patience Haggin / Wall Street Journal: Trade Desk's market cap fell ~70% from a December 2024 peak as it contends with frustrated agency partners, competition from Google, and a new entrant, Amazon — The company lost about 70% of its value as Amazon gained ground and relationships with top ad agencies soured
